DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒に「旅行用」とありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The envelope says “For travel,” I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が家計を整理するために書いた言葉です。口座の正式な名前ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒の私的分類と正式名を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote that to organize my household finances. It is not the account's official name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish your private classification on the envelope from the official name. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中の書類は何のご用件ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What do you need help with regarding the documents inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この申込書の相談です。メモの言葉で手続きが変わるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際の申込用件を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want advice about this application form. I don't think the wording in my note changes the procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify what you actually want to apply for. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申込書の内容から確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's start by checking the application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 封筒から用紙だけ出します。ほかの家計メモは自分で持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出用紙と私的メモを分離する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take just the form out of the envelope. I'll keep my other household finance notes myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the form to submit from your private notes. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用紙のこの欄はまだ空いていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This field on the form is still blank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 用途を書きかけましたが、欄の意味を知ってから記入したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未記入欄の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I started writing the purpose, but I'd like to understand what the field means before filling it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the blank field means. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member responsible will explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私的な分類と申込欄の質問を分けて、説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 分類を流用せず説明に沿って記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep my private classification separate from my question about the application field and listen to the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill it in according to the explanation without reusing your private classification. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、申込書の欄から担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll ask the staff member about the application field first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かごのことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 片方の持ち手が外れたので、両手で下を支えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かごの故障と支え方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: One handle came off, so I'm supporting the bottom with both hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the basket's damage and how you are supporting it. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しいかごをお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll bring you a new basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。今のかごは高く持ち上げず、台に置きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 安全に置く台を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I'd like to set this one on a stand without lifting it high.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a stand where you can put it down safely. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この台を使ってください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 置きました。中の卵を先に、新しいかごへ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 壊れやすい商品から移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've put it down. I'll move the eggs inside to the new basket first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move the fragile items first. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品の状態も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the condition of the items too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 卵は割れていません。ほかの品も落としていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 商品が落下していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The eggs aren't cracked. I haven't dropped any of the other items either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the items have not fallen. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 古いかごはこちらで回収します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。外れた場所は野菜売場でした。部品が残っていないか見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部品が残る可能性のある場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. The handle came off in the vegetable section. Could you check whether any parts are still there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify where parts might remain. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 古いかごを回収し、売場の部品も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll collect the old basket and check for parts in that section too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 影の写真は撮れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you able to photograph the shadow?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雲が出て、さっきの影が見えなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 天候で影が消えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Clouds came out, and the shadow from earlier disappeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the weather made the shadow disappear. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の写真は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have the earlier photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。今の写真と並べて、光の違いを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既存写真との比較を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'd like to put it beside the current photo and compare the light.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest comparing it with an existing photo. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ場所から撮ると比べやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Taking it from the same place will make comparison easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 場所を変えずにもう一枚撮ります。明るさの設定もそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場所と設定を統一する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take another without moving. I'll match the brightness settings too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the location and settings the same. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の課題へ移ることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can move on to another task as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず比較を仕上げてから、葉の形を撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 比較後に別課題へ移る順を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to finish the comparison first, then photograph the shapes of leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to move to another task after the comparison. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写す対象へ近付きすぎないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please don't get too close to what you're photographing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花壇へ入らず、通路から見える葉を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路から撮れる対象を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose leaves visible from the path, without entering the flower bed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a subject you can photograph from the path. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、光の比較と葉の形を順に撮ってみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's photograph the light comparison and the leaf shapes in that order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘を畳む場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to fold your umbrella?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここで振ると、隣の方に水がかかりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水が周囲へかかる懸念を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I shake it here, water might splash onto the person next to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express concern about splashing water on those nearby. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 水を振り落とさず、広い場所で畳んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please fold it in a spacious area without shaking off the water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 場所を教えてください。かばんには書類が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 収納場所と書類の存在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please show me where. There are documents in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where to put it away and mention the documents. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内所の横で、通路を空けてどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can do it beside the information desk, keeping the walkway clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで畳んで、専用の袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の場所で傘袋を使うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll fold it there and put it in its own sleeve.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to use an umbrella sleeve in another location. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の口は閉じられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you close the opening of the sleeve?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。でも、書類とは別の外側ポケットへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類から離した収納を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But I'll put it in an outside pocket separate from the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose storage away from the documents. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手元の切符も濡らさないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the ticket in your hand dry too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切符は先に内側へしまいました。傘を畳んでから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符を守り移動の順を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've already put the ticket inside first. I'll move on after folding the umbrella.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Protect the ticket and explain the order before moving. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、横の場所をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please use the space beside us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この人数の欄は空いていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This field for the number of people is blank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一緒に住む人数か、家族全員かが分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数欄の対象が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't know whether it means the people living together or the whole family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure whom the number-of-people field covers. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの相談票か、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's ask the staff member which consultation form this is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同居は二人ですが、別に住む父も家族なので迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居と別居家族の事実を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two of us live together, but my father who lives elsewhere is family too, so I wasn't sure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the facts about household members and family living separately. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同居と扶養の関係は別に聞かれる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Living together and financial dependency may be asked about separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父を同居の人数に入れず、関係は別に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 関係を別項目として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't include my father in the household count; I'll explain our relationship separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the relationship as a separate item. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この欄の対象を確かめてから書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check whom this field covers before writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 数字だけを先に埋めず、同居二人というメモを添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象確認前に数字を記入しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't fill in just a number first. I'll attach a note saying two people live together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not enter a number before confirming whom it covers. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お父様についての資料もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have documents about your father too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: あります。今は必要か分からないので、別に持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別居家族の資料を分けて待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I don't know whether they're needed now, so I'll keep them separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep documents about family living separately apart while waiting. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、人数欄の意味と資料の要否を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll ask the staff member what the count means and whether the documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前をお呼びしたときに分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you know when we call your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 声だけだと聞き取りにくいので、目で確認できる方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音声だけでは聞取りづらいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have trouble understanding speech alone. Is there a way I can check visually?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that spoken announcements alone are hard to hear. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示画面を見る方法を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask the staff member about checking the display screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。耳が聞こえにくいことも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の聞こえ方を担当へ共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Please also tell them that I have difficulty hearing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Share how well you can hear with the staff member. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待つ場所は今のお席でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is your current seat suitable for waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面に背を向けているので、見える席へ移りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画面が見える席を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My back is to the screen, so I'd like to move to a seat where I can see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a seat with a view of the screen. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの席なら画面が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can see the screen from this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 移りました。表示の名前と受付の控えを照らします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示と受付控えを照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've moved. I'll compare the name displayed with my reception slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the display against the reception slip. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない表示があればお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask if there's anything on the display you don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。同じ姓だけで判断せず、自分の名前か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同姓を区別して呼出しを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't judge just by a matching surname; I'll check whether it's my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish people with the same surname when checking the call. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 呼出しの補助が必要なことを担当へ伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll let the staff member know you need help with being called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車に傷があったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: There was a scratch on your bicycle, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、誰かが付けたところは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原因を見ていないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I didn't see anyone make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State clearly that you did not see what caused it. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝、乗ろうとしたときです。昨夜は暗くてよく見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見時刻と夜の未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This morning, when I was about to ride it. It was dark last night, so I didn't look closely.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you found it and that you didn't check last night. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に傷がなかったと確認したのはいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When did you last confirm there was no scratch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の昼です。それ以降のどの時点かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無傷を確認した最終時点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday afternoon. I don't know at what point after that it happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the last time you confirmed it was undamaged. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝の写真はあります。傷を直す前に状態を残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現状の写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have photos from this morning. I recorded its condition before repairing the scratch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show photos of its current condition. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発見した場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell me where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自宅の駐輪場です。故意か事故かは決めつけずに相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見場所と相談の範囲を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: In the bicycle parking area at home. I'd like advice without assuming it was intentional or accidental.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify where you found it and limit the scope of your consultation. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、分かる時点と現状を順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll ask in order about the times you know and its current condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛名のこの文字を確認してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I check this character in the recipient's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し崩して書きました。相手の名前はこのメッセージの表記です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 正式な宛名表記を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote it a little loosely. The recipient's name is spelled as shown in this message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the correct spelling of the recipient's name. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別の字に見える可能性がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It could be mistaken for another character.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書き足すより、新しい封筒へはっきり書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不明瞭な宛名の書直しを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Rather than add strokes, I'll rewrite it clearly on a new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose to rewrite the unclear recipient's name. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住所も一緒に移してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please copy the address over too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前を写してから、住所を一行ずつ見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前と住所を順に転記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll copy the name first, then check the address one line at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Copy the name and address in order. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身を移すときにもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check when transferring the contents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい封筒に手紙を入れました。古いほうは空です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中身の移動と旧封筒の空を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put the letter in the new envelope. The old one is empty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the contents have been moved and the old envelope is empty. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き直した宛名をもう一度お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the rewritten recipient's name once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の表記と一致しています。新しい一通だけ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式表記を照合し新版だけ出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It matches the original spelling. I'll send only the new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare against the correct spelling and send only the new version. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、書き直した封筒をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll take the rewritten envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方も一緒に相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will the person with you join the consultation too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は私だけで話したいです。家族には少し待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最初は本人だけで相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to speak alone at first. I'll ask my family to wait a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to consult alone at first. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かりました。ここでは話しにくい内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Is it something difficult to discuss here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。周りに聞こえにくい場所があるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 私的な内容に配慮した場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'd like to ask whether there's somewhere others are less likely to overhear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a place that respects the private nature of the discussion. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使える場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check what space is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人確認は私がします。家族に代わりに答えてもらうつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が確認に答えると明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll answer the identity verification questions myself. I don't intend to have my family answer for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that you will answer the verification questions yourself. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 後で同席を希望される場合はお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please let us know if you want them to join later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから、共有する範囲を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明後に家族との共有範囲を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll hear the explanation first, then decide how much to share.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide how much to share with family after hearing the explanation. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今はお一人での相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: For now, you're consulting on your own, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。家族にも、終わるまで待つよう伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同伴者の待機を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've told my family to wait until I'm finished too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the person accompanying you will wait. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、相談場所を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check the consultation space before showing you there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の商品をお渡ししますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll hand over the item you reserved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今、家族から同じ品を別に予約したと連絡が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族からの重複予約連絡を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family has just contacted me to say they separately reserved the same item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report your family's message about a duplicate reservation. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの予約を取り消したいということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean you want to cancel this reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず、今の段階で変更できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更可能性を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: First, I'd like to know whether a change is possible at this stage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether a change is possible first. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the staff member responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族の予約番号も聞いて、同じ予約を二人で見ていないか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約番号で同一案件か照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask for my family's reservation number too and check whether we're both looking at the same reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare reservation numbers to check whether it is the same reservation. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの番号は控えに書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This reservation number is written on your slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は違いました。別の予約が二つあるようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別番号の二件と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The numbers were different. There seem to be two separate reservations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report two reservations with different numbers. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更の可否はまだ確認中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We're still checking whether a change is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。取消になったと思わず、返事を待って受け取り方を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未取消のまま可否を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't assume it's canceled; I'll wait for the answer before deciding how to collect the item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for a decision while recognizing it has not been canceled. Explain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二件の番号を踏まえて担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check with the staff member using both reservation numbers.
